baseline_models.focus_anchor: The whole construction: they say "mixed bundles of dreams" and then disclaim being knowers of their ta'wil.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers publicly classify the dream material as internally mixed and make that classification the ground of a first-person-plural refusal of expertise: disorder is assigned to the object and non-knowledge to the speakers.

activation_trace.role: Voiced speech carries the classification out as the council's public verdict.
Entangled dreams supply the asserted defect that is made to block interpretation.
Dream-vision identifies both the dismissed object and the repeated domain of expertise.
Return to an eventual meaning supplies the operation the speakers disclaim.
Knowledge as disclosure frames their explicit lack of access to what the dreams disclose.

changed_reading.before: They simply say that they cannot interpret dreams.
changed_reading.after: They first declare this dream-complex intrinsically confused and then use that diagnosis to place it outside their competence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contact between adghath, ta'wil, and 'alimin.
baseline_models.mechanism: A grasped handful of unlike stems is one object without internal sorting. Returning it to its outcomes would require differentiating its components by reliable marks; the denial says that this separating-and-routing competence is absent.

activation_trace.role: A mixed handful supplies a materially composite object that must be separated without ceasing to be one grasp.
Return to destination makes interpretation a routing of each sign toward what it becomes.
A distinguishing mark supplies the missing criterion for sorting the bundled signs.

changed_reading.before: Interpretation means attaching a gloss to a dream.
changed_reading.after: Interpretation would unbundle a composite signal and route its marked parts to their eventual referents; the speakers disclaim that discrimination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural qalu / nahnu / 'alimin frame rather than an individual confession.
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech as deliberation in an affair, followed by a corporate 'we,' stages an expert-body judgment. The response does not only report several private deficits; it draws a collective boundary around what this body recognizes as knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Negotiated speech turns the answer into a council-level determination rather than an isolated utterance.
A saying that circulates among people gives the verdict a socially consolidating force.
Recognized knowledge is the jurisdiction whose boundary the plural speakers jointly police.

changed_reading.before: No individual present happens to know the answer.
changed_reading.after: The assembled experts collectively delimit what their institution will admit as interpretable knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ta'wil is requested, promised before an event arrives, and followed by mutually exclusive embodied outcomes whose affair is declared complete. The sequence turns ta'wil from a verbal gloss into a forecast that returns images to events and is answerable to their arrival.

activation_trace.role: Return to an outcome anchors the focus denial in an eventual rather than merely lexical meaning.
The prisoners request a return from seen images to what those images will become.
Promised ta'wil before the event arrives makes futurity part of the interpretive operation.
Completion closes the interpretive chain when the announced outcomes are settled.
The concrete affair is the state of things in which the dream's returned meaning terminates.

structural_cues: 12:36 asks for ta'wil, 12:37 promises it before arrival, and 12:41 assigns two opposed outcomes before closing the affair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated ta'wil, prior prediction, and completed outcomes; I infer that event-arrival tests interpretation, while the live alternative is a verbal explanation that is merely confirmed afterward.

changed_reading.before: The council lacks a verbal explanation of dream symbols.
changed_reading.after: The council lacks the capacity to return dream signs to the concrete outcomes they will become.

context_deltas.mechanism: The alleged mixture repeats a count across three sets, pairs opposed conditions, and makes eating cross from animal image to resource depletion; the later reading expands these channels into a timed agricultural program. Mixedness therefore changes from random noise into dense multiplexing.

activation_trace.role: The mixed handful anchors the focus classification that context will revalue as compact composition.
Distinguishing marks make repeated number, condition, and action readable as separate channels.
The same number marks cattle, cattle, and ears, binding unlike images into one counted structure.
Fatness supplies one pole of a resource-state contrast rather than an ornamental detail.
Eating supplies the transfer action that links the two opposed sets.
Loss of fat supplies the depleted pole that later maps to scarcity.
Crossing a dream from surface to meaning names the operation that preserves relations while changing domains.
Cultivation expands the image-system into the first executable phase of the program.
Protection inside an enclosure supplies the preservation rule that completes the encoded sequence.

structural_cues: 12:43 repeats seven across three image sets, pairs fat with lean and green with dry, and repeats eating.
12:47-49 unfolds the same relations into seven years of production, seven years of depletion, protected remainder, and relief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence, opposition, cross-domain eating, and a matching timed plan; I infer that these are compositional grammar, while a live alternative is that the interpreter imposes order on genuinely loose material.

changed_reading.before: The images are a random heap whose mixture proves meaninglessness.
changed_reading.after: The images are a compressed multi-channel program whose density is misclassified as noise.

context_deltas.mechanism: A forgotten connection is restored after the council's refusal; news is then routed to an absent truth-marked respondent and carried back. The failure belongs to the room's memory and access network, not to the dream's inherent interpretability.

activation_trace.role: Council speech anchors the local body whose negotiated answer initially closes inquiry.
Disclosed knowledge is denied by the present speakers but remains available elsewhere.
Loss from memory supplies the broken link that keeps relevant expertise out of the room.
Recovery after forgetting reactivates the previously unavailable route to knowledge.
A report that comes from elsewhere makes interpretation transferable across social distance.
Dispatch converts recovered memory into movement toward the absent interpreter.
Truthfulness marks the remote respondent as a credible alternative to the council's closure.

structural_cues: 12:44 is immediately followed by delayed remembrance, a request to be sent out, consultation of an absent prisoner, and intended return to the people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgetting, remembering, dispatch, and a credible remote respondent; I infer that ignorance is localized to a failed social route, while the alternative is the narrower claim that the council sincerely knows no interpreter among itself.

changed_reading.after: The present council lacks access to the knower; its ignorance is local, socially routed, and reversible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The interpreted sequence becomes a preservation protocol, and the interpreter is later made secure and trusted before pairing preservation with knowledge over the stores. Knowing ta'wil is thus demonstrated as responsible control of consequences, not only symbolic fluency.

activation_trace.role: Setting an affair in order activates ta'wil as governance of the outcome disclosed by the signs.
Knowledge as disclosure anchors the competence the council denies possessing.
Empowerment turns successful disclosure into capacity to act within the polity.
Settled trust supplies the social warrant for converting interpretation into stewardship.
Securing stores is the material field in which interpretive knowledge must preserve its result.
Guarding and watching make preservation one half of the interpreter's stated competence.
Knowledge paired with guarding identifies actionable disclosure rather than detached explanation.

structural_cues: 12:47-49 gives a storage-and-release plan; 12:54-55 converts its speaker into a trusted official over the stores.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the plan, empowerment, trust, stores, and the paired qualities hafiz/'alim; I infer an operational criterion of knowing, while the live alternative keeps governance as a later reward distinct from interpretation itself.

changed_reading.before: The speakers lack a specialist vocabulary for dreams.
changed_reading.after: They lack actionable knowledge able to preserve a polity through the outcome encoded by the dream.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch permits ahlam to activate forbearance or rational persons. Nearby scattered authorities, ungrounded labels, singular judgment, and failure to know then support a reflexive reading: the council's own deliberative faculties are bundled and cannot order multiple appearances toward one governing outcome.

activation_trace.role: Forbearance and rational maturity supply the alternative sense of ahlam as minds or deliberative faculties.
A mixed grasp makes those faculties a crowded bundle rather than an ordered council.
Ordering and governing an affair supplies the integrative operation the bundled counsel cannot perform.
Scattering into parts supplies the nearby institutional image of competing authorities.
Union in one direction supplies the unifying counterform that the mixed counsel lacks.
Names as mere designations show verbal labels proliferating without an ordering warrant.
Compelling warrant supplies what the proliferating labels and the later verdict do not possess.
Right-judging wisdom supplies the coherent alternative to scattered deliberation.
The nearby failure of people to know makes the focus denial part of a wider epistemic disorder.

structural_cues: 12:39 contrasts scattered lords with one; 12:40 moves from unsupported names to singular judgment and closes with widespread non-knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ahlam's rational-person branch and a context of scattered versus unified authority; I infer that the court speakers embody the dispersion they name, while ordinary dream-visions remain the syntactically dominant alternative.

changed_reading.before: The experts diagnose mixed dreams outside themselves.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their answer also diagnoses mixed deliberative minds unable to govern signs toward an outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later scene moves within one exchange from questioning, through a plural declaration of knowledge, to individual confession as truth becomes manifest. That sequence reopens the focus council's plural speech as a socially forceful but revisable framing rather than a final epistemic fact.

activation_trace.role: Negotiated speech anchors the focus verdict as an institutional product capable of later renegotiation.
Successive speakers in one affair display collective speech changing shape under renewed inquiry.
Truth emerging into visibility supplies the event that breaks a prior social framing.
Manifesting what is fixed against reality gives revision an evidential rather than merely rhetorical basis.
Truth of speech identifies the standard by which the revised declaration displaces the earlier frame.

structural_cues: 12:51 sequences a question, a collective answer, and a single confession before the verse ends.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit later reversal inside plural and singular speech; I infer analogous caution toward the council's consensus, while the live alternative is that the two speaking groups have no direct epistemic equivalence.

changed_reading.before: The plural answer is a settled expert verdict on the dream.
changed_reading.after: The answer is a provisional consensus whose social certainty may exceed its epistemic warrant.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a noun used to dismiss the vision becomes material foreshadowing. It remains anchored because the focus branch literally supplies a mixed handful of stems while the context makes ears, harvest, leaving, and enclosure the solution. Render it only as an exploratory material echo, not as a claim that adghath lexically means stored grain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Adghath at 12:44 as a mixed vegetal handful.

activation_trace.role: A hand-gathered mixture of stems supplies the concrete bundle hidden inside the dismissive label.
Ears of grain place vegetal stalk-forms inside the dream that the council calls a mixed handful.
Growing crop turns the dream's vegetal material into the medium of the practical response.
Cutting the crop produces the stems and ears that can remain materially gathered.
Leaving the crop in place reverses the impulse to dismantle the bundle immediately.
The ear becomes a natural package whose retained form protects what it contains.
Enclosed protection reveals bundling as a preservation technology rather than mere confusion.

changed_reading.before: The bundle image only figures random mixture and interpretive failure.
changed_reading.after: The vegetal bundle ironically previews the sheaf-like storage logic by which the vision is solved.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet-resolved non-dominant q-w-l to q-l-l target rather than ordinary qawl morphology. It remains anchored at qalu, is coupled to the mixed handful, and is reactivated by later q-l-l occurrences. Render it only as a split-root acoustic/branch activation, never as a standard lexical derivation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Qalu at 12:44 under the packet's non-dominant q-l-l mapping.

activation_trace.role: Agitated movement makes the utterance itself participate in the instability it attributes to the dreams.
The mixed grasp supplies the disorder that the split-root activation reflects back onto the speech.
A little portion becomes the exception to consumption and weakens the council's totalizing dismissal.
A little protected remainder survives depletion, giving smallness decisive structural force.

changed_reading.before: Qalu neutrally introduces a settled expert judgment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the utterance is itself unsettled, and the later decisive 'little' exposes its blanket dismissal as too coarse.

strongest_changes: Mixedness changes from proof of nonsense into the compressed coexistence of count, contrast, transfer, and temporal sequence.
Ta'wil changes from verbal gloss into an event-answerable return of signs to outcomes.
The plural denial changes from global uninterpretability into a local failure of memory, access, and institutional routing.
Knowledge changes from symbolic expertise into preservation, trust, and stewardship of consequences.
summary.what_was_special: The context preserves several readings at once: it reverses noise into program, makes the dismissive vegetal bundle echo the storage solution, permits ahlam to expose disordered counsel, and leaves a contained split-root activation in which the verdict itself trembles.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not decide whether the dream natively encodes the later program or whether the interpreter imposes a successful organization on loose material.
Dream-visions remain the dominant sense of ahlam; the rational-counsel reading is deliberately exploratory.
The vegetal-bundle echo and q-l-l split activation are material and acoustic traces, not claims of ordinary lexical equivalence.
